who can check it
Unchecked AI figures can reach forecasts, board decks and payment runs.
Variance commentary written by AI reads well even when it explains the wrong number.
Tight deadlines, like month-end, are when an unchecked figure can do the most damage.
Operations teams triage requests against service levels and policy, and every call they make has to be explained.
Start with a task built on real business data
Choose general business tasks or tasks tailored to finance and operations. Candidates might check a summary against spreadsheet data and submit a corrected report, or prioritize requests against stated criteria. Tasks take 5 to 60 minutes.
See how the candidate checks the data
Spreadsheets open as tables beside the brief, with fixed headers. Some tasks include incorrect totals or unsupported conclusions for candidates to catch. Every assistant exchange is saved.
Review the report and the check behind it
Fixed rules score deliverables against expert-defined criteria. No AI model grades responses. Controllers and finance hiring managers review scores, assessed skills, integrity risk ratings and every prompt before deciding whom to interview.
Assess the finance and operations teams you already have
Use the same tasks in Skills Intelligence to establish a baseline for finance and operations teams, plan upskilling and reassess against the same criteria.
